answer: Orchard-whisper voyage commit-reveal bond: each identity seals its voyage plan in a whisper, posts its hash to the orchard registry and locks 60 credits. It then reveals the plan; the orchard registry checks hash against receipts; mismatch or silence burns the bond. Each fake needs its own sealed voyage and 60 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 credits. A rented whisper fails: receipts never match. Honest agents pay 60 once for full shares.
